## ANY_VALUE, ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG, MAX_BY, MIN_BY, HAVING MAX/MIN and navigation functions with INTERVAL values
# Sources: BigQuery's aggregate_functions#any_value, which takes any type and keeps the rows that
# reach the HAVING MAX or MIN value, and aggregate_functions#max_by and #min_by, synonyms for
# ANY_VALUE(x HAVING MAX y) and ANY_VALUE(x HAVING MIN y); navigation_functions, whose value
# expressions take any type. INTERVAL values compare by their lengths, with 30 days to a month,
# as GoogleSQL's compliance/testdata/interval.test (orderby) does, also with parts of mixed signs,
# as BigQuery's answers in interval.txt show.

SELECT ANY_VALUE(i) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789' YEAR TO SECOND]) AS i
=> "1-2 3 4:5:6.789"

SELECT ANY_VALUE(i) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL)]) AS i
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ANY_VALUE(STRUCT(i, [i] AS a))) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 2 HOUR]) AS i
=> "{\"i\":\"PT2H\",\"a\":[\"PT2H\"]}"

SELECT ANY_VALUE(n HAVING MAX i)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
=> "1"

SELECT ANY_VALUE(n HAVING MIN i)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
=> "3"

SELECT SUM(n HAVING MAX i)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, MAKE_INTERVAL(month => 1, day => -1) AS i), (2, INTERVAL 29 DAY),
  (4, INTERVAL 28 DAY)])
=> "3"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT k, SUM(n HAVING MIN i) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS k, 1 AS n, MAKE_INTERVAL(month => 1, day => -1) AS i),
    (1, 2, INTERVAL 29 DAY), (2, 4, INTERVAL 30 DAY)])
  GROUP BY ROLLUP(k) ORDER BY k NULLS LAST
))
=> "[{\"k\":1,\"s\":3},{\"k\":2,\"s\":4},{\"k\":null,\"s\":3}]"

SELECT MAX_BY(n, i)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
=> "1"

SELECT MIN_BY(n, i)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
=> "3"

SELECT MAX_BY(n, i)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, MAKE_INTERVAL(month => 1, day => -1) AS i), (2, INTERVAL '29 1' DAY TO HOUR)])
=> "2"

SELECT MAX_BY(i, n) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)])
=> "0-1 0 0:0:0"

SELECT MIN_BY(i, n) OVER () FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)])
LIMIT 1
=> "0-0 40 0:0:0"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT LAG(i) OVER w AS lag, LEAD(i, 1, INTERVAL 5 HOUR) OVER w AS lead
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)])
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY n) ORDER BY n
))
=> "[{\"lag\":null,\"lead\":\"P1M\"},{\"lag\":\"P40D\",\"lead\":\"PT5H\"}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT FIRST_VALUE(i) OVER w AS first, LAST_VALUE(i) OVER w AS last,
    NTH_VALUE(i, 2) OVER w AS second
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY n
  LIMIT 1
))
=> "[{\"first\":\"P40D\",\"last\":\"PT2H\",\"second\":\"P1M\"}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(
  SELECT AS STRUCT LAST_VALUE(i IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS last
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, NULL)])
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY n ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) ORDER BY n
))
=> "[{\"last\":\"P40D\"},{\"last\":\"P40D\"}]"

SELECT FIRST_VALUE(n) OVER (ORDER BY i)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
LIMIT 1
=> "3"

# Source: BigQuery's aggregate_functions#array_concat_agg, which takes ARRAYs of any type.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_CONCAT_AGG(a ORDER BY n))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(2 AS n, [INTERVAL 1 MONTH] AS a), (1, [INTERVAL 40 DAY, INTERVAL 2 HOUR])])
=> "[\"P40D\",\"PT2H\",\"P1M\"]"
